NVIDIA (NVDA) grew annual revenue 8.0x in 4 years. What do the numbers say about that growth, and what don’t they say?

SEC financial snapshot · FY2026 (ended Jan 25, 2026)
• Revenue: $215.9B (+65.5% YoY)
• Operating margin: 60.4%
• Free cash flow: $96.7B (44.8% of revenue)

Latest quarter (ended Jul 26, 2026, 10-Q)
• Revenue: $96.2B (+105.9% vs the same quarter a year earlier)
• Operating margin: 66.2%

4-year view (FY2022 → FY2026)
• Revenue: $26.9B → $215.9B
• Operating margin: 37.3% → 60.4%

These are historical financial observations. They do not by themselves establish the drivers of growth, a research thesis or fair value.

Source: NVIDIA Form 10-K for FY2026, filed with the SEC on Feb 25, 2026. Reconcile figures to this filing.
